text: EmergingGrowth.com Daily Dozen – Winners vs. Losers January 17, 2018 Telegram Stocks soared on Wednesday, after Apple, Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL) announced plans to invest $350 billion in the US over the next five years. Overall, the Dow Jones surged 1.25%, S&P 500 jumped 0.94%, and Nasdaq soared 1.03%, during trading on Wednesday, January 17, 2018. Oil back on top, while metals sag: crude oil rallied 0.44%, gold dropped 0.70%, and silver dove 1.01%. Micro-cap caps rallied on Wednesday, as nine of the ten indices saw gains today. Leading the rally was the OTCM ADR Index, which jumped 0.76%. On the other hand, the OTCQX U.S. Index was the sole loser on Wednesday, dropping 0.73%. OTC Markets 2018-01-17 Today’s Top OTC Winners: SkyFidelity, Inc. (OTC Pink: SRMX) +215.79%: Shares of the Internet of Things technology developer skyrocketed 215.79% on Wednesday, after the company announced it has entered into a product development agreement with AT&T, Inc. (NYSE: T). Nightfood Holdings, Inc. (OTC Pink: NGTF) +64.67%: The snack foods company shot up 64.67% on Wednesday, but there was no official news or press released today. Overall, the stock saw volume of 2.64 million shares on the day. First Federal of Northern Michigan Bancorp, Inc. (OTCQX: FFNM) +34.66%: Shares of the community bank holding company surged 34.66% on Wednesday, January 17, 2018. Overall, the stock saw volume of 1.32 million shares on the day. Today’s Top OTC Losers: Joblocationmap, Inc. (OTC Pink: JBCT) -44.11%: Shares of the essential oils distributor collapsed 44.11% on Wednesday, but there was no recent news or press from the company.
